Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.P.P. for
 the State.

2. This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants- Kamlesh Yadav and Sunita Devi
with prayer to release on bail in connection with Pocso Case No.30 of 2024 (arising out of Ranka
P.S. Case No.14/2024) registered under Section 366 of the Indian Penal Code but later on section
376-Ab/34 of Ipc and section 6 of Pocso Act has been added, pending in the court of learned
Special Judge, Pocso Act, Garhwa.

3. As per allegations made in the FIR that the phone call came from the phone number of the daughter of informant from the mobile no. 9199907426 and from very day she was enticed away by some unknown persons.
Hence, the FIR was lodged.
4. During investigation, the victim was recovered and her statement under sections 161 and 164 of Cr.PC was also recorded.
5. The learned counsel for the petitioner has also submitted that in this case, trial has commenced.
The victim, doctor and the father of victim, 3 witnesses have been examined.
The deposition statement of them are being annexed with supplementary-affidavit.
6. In her statement victim before the trial court has stated that it was Dinanath who had given the mobile number to her and used to talk with her.

He had taken her to Danapur where she lived with Kamlesh Yadav vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp. ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157888078/
1 him for 5 days.

sentences.text: She also stated that she is not aware what is concerned of Dinanath with the two accused persons.
She refuses to identify accused Kamlesh Yadav and Sunita Devi i.e. both petitioners herein.
7. In view of the testimony of victim before the trial court, the bail application of the applicants is hereby allowed.

Let the applicants be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in aforesaid case.
